name: Untimely Death
overview: Scripture reveals that human life is limited and sovereignly appointed, as God declares that man's days are set at a certain number (Genesis 6:3). Even in the face of death, the believer finds comfort and courage because the LORD is their shepherd, guiding and protecting them through the darkest valleys (Psalms 23:1,4). The death of God's saints is precious in His sight, affirming His care and purpose even in untimely death (Psalms 116:15). Moreover, God’s intimate knowledge of each person's life and the days they will live underscores His sovereign plan and providence over all life and death (Psalms 139:16).
